title: When to Use Cosine Rule
text:
Use the Cosine Rule when you have:
- Two sides and the **included** angle (SAS) - to find the third side
- Three sides (SSS) - to find any angle

title: The Cosine Rule Formula
text:
The Cosine Rule: $$a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc \cos A$$

This is like Pythagoras but with a correction term for non-right triangles.

title: Correct Formula
text:
For finding side a with sides b, c and angle A:
$$a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc \cos A$$
